title: Lightning Hits Earth 100 Times a Second. Would You Survive?
description:
Right now lightning is flashing about a hundred times every second somewhere on Earth. It hunts the tallest thing around: the Empire State Building gets hit about 25 times a year. One park ranger, Roy Sullivan, was struck seven different times and lived through every one. Every bolt is hotter than the surface of the sun, hot enough to turn sand into glass. But your car protects you, and it's not the rubber tires, it's the metal shell.

Would you stay inside the car? 👇

#lightning #science #storm #weather #shorts
lines: Right now, lightning is flashing about a hundred times every second, somewhere on Earth.
And it hunts for the tallest thing around. The Empire State Building gets hit about twenty-five times a year.
One park ranger, Roy Sullivan, got struck seven different times, and lived through every single one.
Every bolt is hotter than the surface of the sun, hot enough to turn sand into glass.
But your car protects you. Not the rubber tires, the metal shell. Would you stay inside?
